prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: AI Developer Needed For Custom Chatbot Business
Need an AI / ML / NLP developer to develop our product. This product will be a completely custom chatbot and frontend/backend paired with a google extension. UIUX experience is nice to have as well but not required. Looking for a technical co-founder.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and genuinely excited by opportunities to build products that solve real problems. With 7 years of experience in web development, I bring a strong full-stack foundation and the ability to move quickly from idea to implementation.

Your need for a custom chatbot product with a paired frontend, backend, and Google extension is the kind of challenge I’m well suited for. I work comfortably across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, which gives me the flexibility to help shape both the user-facing experience and the underlying application architecture.

While my background is broader full-stack product development, I’m especially interested in AI-driven products and the opportunity to contribute as a technical co-founder. I understand that a project like this requires more than just coding — it needs clear product thinking, strong technical decisions, and the ability to build something dependable, scalable, and easy to use. I’d be focused on helping you turn the concept into a clean, functional product that can support real users.

I also understand the importance of a polished interface. Even though UI/UX is not required, I can contribute to the overall product experience by building intuitive layouts and smooth workflows that make the chatbot feel natural and easy to adopt. If needed, I can help shape both the frontend experience and the backend structure so the product stays maintainable as it grows.

For the Google extension side, I’m comfortable working on connected browser-based functionality and integrating it into the broader system. I’d approach the build with a practical, product-first mindset, keeping performance, usability, and long-term extensibility in mind.

If you’re looking for someone who can contribute as a technically strong partner and help bring a custom chatbot product to life, I’d be glad to discuss how I can support the build.
